purpose: First fixed engineering local-alignment check, not calibrated place identity or task completion
input: Original current-frame finite raw returns in existing 10m local domain; no voxel sampling; commanded sensor poses only
selection: All 560 already saved top-five candidates across 115 native epochs; no threshold/score reselection

rationale.distance: 0.5m equals existing patch spatial unit; RMSE cap is half that unit, normals use two units; fixed before output inspection
rationale.overlap: Require at least half of all original local returns and 30 correspondences in both directions; normal filtering never shrinks denominator
rationale.normal_quality: Six-point minimum and explicit surface/linearity guards reject unstable local fits
rationale.solver: Single point-to-plane ICP initialized by recorded relative pose, 50 iterations maximum, no global alignment or retry
rationale.degeneracy: Require all six dimensionless information modes at fixed 1e-6 relative scale; not a calibrated uncertainty or proof of unique place

failure_policy: Keep every rejected/ambiguous candidate and all original task states. Do not tune this configuration from these results or call local fit a confirmed task match.
